prior_to_rotation: Know clinic address, phone, and front desk contacts
Confirm supervision schedule with assigned attending for your clinic day
Set up Zoom workflow for virtual appointments before clinic starts
overview: Longitudinal child outpatient psychiatry at W.O. Walker Building — mix of in-person and virtual visits with direct attending supervision toward end of each appointment.
location: W.O. Walker Building, Suite 1155A, 10524 Euclid Avenue, Cleveland OH 44106
personnel: Supervision: Dr. Makino (Tuesday AM), Dr. Imfeld (Tuesday PM), Dr. Neil Bruce (Wednesday PM), Dr. Matthew Newton (Friday PM)
Front desk: Chauncey Love, Quiasia Fields, Lester Whittsette, Keisha Hughes; contact Fran Geraci for scheduling issues
schedule: Morning clinics: 8–11 AM patients, 11 AM–12 PM supervision (Dr. Makino Tuesday)
Afternoon clinics: 1–4 PM patients, 4–5 PM supervision (Dr. Imfeld Tuesday, Dr. Neil Bruce Wednesday, Dr. Matthew Newton Friday)
Contact front desk and Fran Geraci ASAP if late or sick
logistics: Zoom: trainees send links before clinic; no-show if patient not on within 15 min — document attempts, inform front desk
Direct supervision with attending toward end of each appointment
Refills through next appointment; controlled substances (stimulants) require separate scripts with DNFB date
Task lists: check minimum 3×/week (beginning, middle, end of week)
Vacation: arrange resident/fellow coverage, inform office staff, set out-of-office message for patients
Notes within 24–48 hours; same-day for high-risk patients (recent CAPU discharge, high suicide risk)
Document risk/benefit for interventions; brief risk assessment (static/dynamic risk and protective factors) each visit
Assigned readings completed by all; one person leads discussion
debrief_prompts: Pediatric formulation — developmental lens on a case from this week
Virtual vs. in-person visit — what changed in your assessment or alliance?
Risk documentation — static vs. dynamic factors on a high-risk patient
Supervision moment — feedback that shifted your plan or documentation
